items.title: Reverse-semistandard-tableau content-product formula for the number of skew standard tableaux
items.difficulty_reason: The retained author route constructs the skew-dimension formula by converting a character inner product into a shifted-factorial determinant, and proves the reverse-tableau expansion via a specialised column-elimination/telescoping calculation yielding an interlacing branching rule. Both nonroutine determinant constructions and their supplied supporting arguments remain in this item, rather than being assumed as black boxes. This provides an H2 burden beyond routine coefficient substitution or a single generic determinant evaluation; variable-name translation, paper length and venue are not the difficulty basis.
